exposure: prophylactic oxytocin use during Caesarean section
outcome: Requirement for additional uterotonic agents or procedures
cohort: Women at increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage after Cesarean section
finding: While there was no significant difference in most outcomes between women receiving carbetocin or oxytocin, carbetocin reduced the need for additional uterotonics or procedures in those with major placenta previa or multiple pregnancies.
mod_finding: Compared to oxytocin, carbetocin may reduce the need for additional uterotonics or procedures during cesarean sections in specific high-risk patient groups, such as those with major placenta previa or multiple pregnancies.
